name: On-Call Handoff
description: Assembling an on-call shift handoff from whatever incident-management tool (Rootly, PagerDuty, BetterStack) is connected, plus corroborating observability signal where available: the four handoff categories in priority order (currently paging, escalated without an owner, last-shift history, known-flaky watch list), why an empty open-incidents list is not an empty handoff, and the bar for calling an alert known-flaky rather than simply resolved.
